newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK 33 mln 91-day T-bills, rate flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK 33 mln 91-day T-bills, rate flat.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it raised 33 million kuna through 91-day treasury bills.
The issue was priced at 96.861 kuna with a 13-percent interest rate, unchanged from three weeks ago.
The ministry planned to sell 40 million, but bids totalled 38.5 million kuna at 10-14 percent rates. The weighted average was 12.39 percent.
The bills are payable on November 14 and they mature on February 13. For full results see page MFHT.
The ministry will next auction 50 million kuna worth of 35-day T-bills on November 26. The auctions are not open to foreign investors. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
